description: This file contains Python code for testing and updating slow test metrics in the PyTorch project, including functions for interacting with GitHub API, querying a database for slow tests, and automating pull request creation and management.

methods.name: git_api
methods.description: Performs GET, POST, or PATCH requests to GitHub API with appropriate headers and token.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a new pull request on GitHub and returns its number.

methods.name: approve_pr
methods.description: Approves a pull request using the GitHub API.

methods.name: make_comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a pull request or issue on GitHub.

methods.name: add_labels
methods.description: Adds labels to a GitHub issue or pull request.

methods.name: search_for_open_pr
methods.description: Searches for an open pull request matching specific criteria and returns its number and branch name.
